content: Depends on: bcf_get_fmt (CL-41), kbs_* (done in CL-27), bcf_remove_allele_set (still C). The 54-line C function gets FORMAT/GT data, builds a bitset of used alleles, then calls bcf_remove_allele_set. Our KBitSet handles the bitset. bcf_get_fmt needs to be replaced first. bcf_remove_allele_set (220 lines) is the heavy dependency — it rewrites INFO+FORMAT fields, so it depends on bcf_update_info (CL-50) + bcf_update_format (CL-51).
